methodologyNotes: 14 notable home projectors a buyer compares in 2026, spanning ultra-short-throw laser, standard-throw home-theater, short-throw gaming, portable LED, and premium native-4K segments. Primary source for all products is ProjectorCentral.com (manufacturer-verified spec database). Prices are US MSRP at launch or last known US MSRP per ProjectorCentral; current street prices may differ. brightness_lumens uses the ISO lumen rating where available, otherwise ANSI lumens as labeled. contrast values are dynamic contrast unless noted (most manufacturers publish only dynamic). throw_type is derived from throw ratio: UST <= 0.4, short > 0.4 to <= 1.0, standard > 1.0, portable = explicitly marketed as portable pico-class. HDR values reflect the highest HDR standard supported. BenQ HT2060 discontinued Dec 2025 but widely compared in 2026 buyer guides. All accessedAt=2026-06-15.
